rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday noun for motivation or encouragement.

example.english: My incentive for going to work every day is seeing satisfied customers’ smiles.
example.traditional: 我每日返工嘅動力，就係見到客人滿意嘅笑容。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 faan1 gung1 ge3 dung6 lik6 zau6 hai6 gin3 dou2 haak3 jan4 mun5 ji3 ge3 siu3 jung4

rows.note: Use this for a general reward offered to encourage better performance, especially when it is not specifically a cash payment.

example.english: The company said there would be an incentive for doing well in this campaign, and everyone immediately became more proactive.
example.traditional: 公司話今次活動做得好有獎勵，大家即刻積極咗。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 waa6 gam1 ci3 wut6 dung6 zou6 dak1 hou2 jau5 zoeng2 lai6 daai6 gaa1 zik1 hak1 zik1 gik6 zo2

rows.note: Use this when the incentive is specifically a monetary bonus or cash payment.

example.english: If we hit the target this month, we’ll get a cash incentive, so everyone is working flat out.
example.traditional: 今個月達標就有獎金，所以大家都搏命做。
example.jyutping: gam1 go3 jyut6 daat6 biu1 zau6 jau5 zoeng2 gam1 so2 ji5 daai6 gaa1 dou1 bok3 meng6 zou6
